purpose: Bounded general-encyclopedia language-modeling diagnostic; not a broad capability benchmark.
selection_rule: Use every eligible title in the fixed candidate list. Do not select or remove pages based on model scores or body text. If fewer than 20 pages pass the predeclared metadata, size, licensing, and attribution rules, stop and record a new candidate-set decision before fetching any article body.
revision_rule: For each exact title, pin the latest revision returned in one metadata-only query. Store its revision ID, timestamp, byte size, SHA-1, content model, canonical title, and oldid permalink. Do not request revision content in this query.

metadata_query.request_policy: Latest revision metadata requested for all candidate titles in one query; pinned revids were then queried serially to confirm main-slot content model and metadata. Both requests used maxlag=5 and a descriptive User-Agent. Neither requested revision content.

eligibility_rules.redirects: exclude and record; do not follow silently
eligibility_rules.license_and_attribution: Before body acquisition, inspect the exact oldid page footer, its history through the pinned revision, and its discussion page for applicable text license, imported-content notices, extra attribution requirements, fair-use or third-party text, and unresolved licensing concerns. Exclude and record any page that fails or remains uncertain.
eligibility_rules.content_scope: Article text only; exclude templates, references, navigation, categories, tables, and non-text media through a deterministic extractor.

preparation_rule.split_unit: complete article revision, then normalized document identity
preparation_rule.duplicate_policy: Retain rows but assign normalized duplicates to one split; report duplicate groups and hashed identities.

audit.body_flag_definition: Per-revision body_fetched=false means the raw revision content field was not requested from the API. Rendered exact-oldid pages were loaded to inspect footers and therefore included article HTML, but no article text was extracted, saved, or used as corpus data.
audit.body_fetch_scope: No raw article revision text was requested through the API or saved as corpus data. Rendered exact-oldid pages were opened to inspect the footer; those page responses included the rendered article, which was not extracted or retained.
audit.history_review_scope: For each pinned oldid, auditors reviewed the rendered footer, the newest 500 revision-history entries at or before the pinned revision, and current discussion-page material. The history window did not reach the beginning of every page history; no page is cleared under the current evidence standard.
